verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's docs officially endorse building against the existing OpenAI SDK as a drop-in replacement: change base_url, api_key and model, and existing code works without modification. That gives AI-native users a well-supported SDK path, but no first-party DeepInfra SDK is evidenced, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec for generating clients. Missing for 10: a first-party DeepInfra SDK (e.g. Python/JS packages), SDK coverage for non-chat endpoints such as image, speech and embeddings, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK compatibility.
